post.threads_text:
Boosting a post is not the same as running ads.

A cafe in Anna Nagar boosts a nice reel. It gets likes, a few new followers, and zero table bookings.

Because the boost was set up for reach, not enquiries.

So before you spend more, ask one thing: what should someone do right after seeing this ad? Call? Message? Book?

If you can't answer that, your ad can't either.

Book a free consultation (link in the reply).

post.linkedin_text:
Most business owners don't have a content problem. They have a time problem.

You know you should post. You even have ideas. But the shop gets busy, customers walk in, and suddenly it's been three weeks since your last reel.

That's the real cost. People check your page before they visit or call. A quiet feed makes them wonder if you're still active.

So at Loyara, we take the "when there's time" part out of it:

→ We plan a monthly content calendar, and you approve it before anything is made
→ We book content days in advance and shoot the reels at your business
→ We write the captions, research hashtags and schedule everything

Our Starter package is ₹15,999/month: 8 reels, 4 static posts and 8 story designs, with 2 content days. If you also want enquiries from ads, Growth (₹19,999/month) adds Meta Ads management and a monthly performance report.

This is for businesses in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu who are really good at what they do, but just don't have the hours to show it online.

If that sounds like you, book a free consultation. Tell me about your business and I'll honestly tell you what fits.
